title: The normalized ordinary scalar-comparison interface
statement: Let $R_n$ be commutative rings with transition maps $c_n:R_{n+1}\to R_n$, let $B$ be a commutative ring, and fix maps $\psi_n:B\to R_n$. Use the actual varying-ring operations [def-sp-varying-ring-operations], proper/open arrows [def-sp-varying-ring-proper-open-arrows], and constant tower calculus [lem-cbc-strict-tower-proper-open-calculus]. Define the scalar map on constant sheaves using $\psi_n$, the constant-tower geometric and open adjunctions by termwise whiskering of the specified module adjunctions, and the square and open compositors from those adjunctions. An ordinary scalar-comparison package consists of exact additive restriction functors with identity section and transition identifications, geometric comparison isomorphisms normalized by direct-image sections and the adjunction units, counits and mate equation, open-extension comparisons normalized by the open units, and constant-tower beta, clopen and alpha data with their defining transpose/compositor words and compatibility with the varying-ring arrows. The level and direct-image section normalizations are pointwise heterogeneous equalities: for every input section x the displayed comparison sends x to a section heterogeneously equal to x.
